description: This file implements a VideoApiAdapter for Nextcloud Talk, providing methods to create, delete, and update video meetings, handle OAuth token management, and interact with Nextcloud API endpoints.

classes.name: NextcloudTalkVideoApiAdapter
classes.description: A factory function that creates a VideoApiAdapter for Nextcloud Talk, managing OAuth tokens and API interactions for video meetings.

methods.name: createMeeting
methods.description: Creates a new video meeting in Nextcloud Talk with parameters derived from the CalendarEvent data.

methods.name: deleteMeeting
methods.description: Deletes an existing video meeting identified by its UID.

methods.name: updateMeeting
methods.description: Returns updated meeting data based on a PartialReference object.
